skills/work-planner/guidelines.md:32:  Put instructions that handle an action's specific output immediately after that action, naming the condition and returned value. Keep detail flush beneath the step heading. Name the returned object explicitly when a pronoun would leave its referent unclear.

skills/work-planner/guidelines.md:34:  Named findings and conditional branches follow the action or scope that governs them.
